Theo Báo Đầu tư, Báo Pháp luật và VnEcon: According to Bao Dau Tu, Bao Phap Luat and VnEconomy, the project covers over 22,000 m² with total investment of over 885 billion VND, to build social housing apartments for sale to eligible beneficiaries, along with a commercial housing portion under the mechanism reserved for developers. Cafeland reports about 846 apartments and 30 commercial townhouses – figures that should be cross-checked with official documents.

We have not found any completed social housing project by the company.
